connectors.name: Wireless module header
connectors.orderNote: No numeric pin 1 mark (small circle by top-left pad not treated as pin 1); started at the end closest to the USB-5V-IN connector (bottom), position 1 = right column (nearest right board edge), alternating columns

uncertain: J2, J12 and J13 labels are printed in a separate legend box beside each connector, not under each pin; assumed the legend order left-to-right matches the pins left-to-right.

J11: the 2x7 pin legend (IO20/IO19 ... 5V/NC) is printed beside J11 and assumed to map column-for-column onto J11 (left legend column = left pad column). It might instead describe the wireless module or J9.
J11 start end: chose the bottom end as nearer the USB-5V-IN connector; a small circle near the top-left pad of J9/J11 could be a pin-1 marker, which would reverse the order.
Combined silkscreen names like IO44-RX0 were split into label IO44 and function RX0.
notes: PCB render of CrowPanel ESP32 Display-7.0 inch (Advance_series) DIS02170A V1.0. J9 (2x7, next to J11) has no per-pin labels and was not transcribed. BAT (J3) battery connector, SPK (J15, only + marked), FPC connectors, TF slot and buttons were skipped. Silkscreen also notes IIC address 0X51 IO15-RTC_SDA IO16-RTC_SCL, SPK I2S IO4-SDIN IO5-BCLK IO6-LRCLK, MIC I2S IO2-WS_PIN IO19-BCK_PIN IO20-DATA_PIN; these are not connector pins.
